name: BMW R1200GS (water-cooled)
engine: 1170 cc air/liquid-cooled boxer twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: The first water-cooled GS. Check the fork tube recall before anything else.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Water-cooled GS and GS Adventure bikes built from November 2013 to June 2017 were recalled because the fixed fork tube can separate after a hard hit. Dealers fit an extra fork tube bush.
A-002.reason: A separated fork tube can cause a loss of steering. The repair is free.

E: After any hard hit or crash, have the fork tubes checked even if the recall bush is fitted.

recalls.what: Fixed fork tube can separate from its top plug after a hard hit.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits an extra fork tube bush free, or replaces a damaged fork.
